📰 Phone Haptics Breakthrough: New Vibration Tech

Research from Immersion Corporation and IEEE reveals a novel methodology for generating realistic, high-fidelity haptic feedback on mobile devices. This approach overcomes limitations of traditional vibration motors by using advanced waveform synthesis and perceptual modeling.
